concept.reason: Actual full skeleton photograph clearly shows crest, bill, trunk, limbs and long tail; sufficient for lowpoly preparation.

scope: Entire adult helmet-crested hadrosaur, not isolated skull or a fossil scan.

scientific_limits.en: Living reconstruction based on museum skeletal anatomy. Ten metres is a genus-level NHM estimate, not the measured size of the photographed mount. Soft tissue, colour, crest thickness and chosen pose are interpretative. Historical mount posture and aquatic interpretation are not adopted.
scientific_limits.zh: 据馆藏骨架形态制作完整活体复原。10米是自然历史博物馆属级估值，不是照片装架的实测长度。软组织、颜色、冠厚度及姿态为复原选择，不沿用旧装架姿态及水栖解释。

scale.basis: NHM genus-level estimate; not AMNH specimen measurement.

diagnostic_targets: High rounded laterally compressed helmet crest above skull; smooth arched outline with broad base on skull, no long backward tube and no separate posterior hatchet spike.
Broad duckbill, long neck, deep torso, powerful hindlimbs, shorter forelimbs and long tapering stiff balancing tail.
Entire animal in low balanced bipedal pose, tail raised clear of ground and forearms below shoulders, not an upright tail-dragging kangaroo.
Crest remains a solid exterior silhouette; internal nasal tubes known but not exposed in intact living model.
Side view must distinguish rounded helmet from Parasaurolophus tube and Lambeosaurus hatchet; top view shows narrow crest, broad bill and adequate trunk volume.
specimen_basis: AMNH photographic asset ptc-7733, nearly complete mounted Corythosaurus skeleton photographed by Lynton Gardiner in1991. Museum mount includes restoration; image has no calibrated scale. Do not identify all bones as original or impose a specimen number absent from this photo record.
acceptance_checks: Whole-organism silhouette and proportions, helmet diagnostic from side/perspective.
Two distinct forelimbs and hindlimbs with continuous anatomical joints; no detached crest or flattened torso.
Four standard views only; preview may reuse perspective bytes.
No web-image reuse claim unless actual renderer/config and original GLB/image hashes satisfy publication contract.
